text: fellow travelers or anyone planning to see O and it's on hiatus. we booked la reve instead. we were staying at encore so theater was just a short walk away. we had seats in like the third row. i knew la reve gets compared to O, maybe even considered a copy of it so i thought it'd be a decent swap. it's not O, but pretty solid. does la reve have a story? maybe, but i didn't get it and didn't mind it. there's a performer who's like a lizard guy in a pool, floats still for a long time looking like a statue then goes and sneaks on people in the front rows, sprays them. the main show is the spectacle. they have the pool, moving platforms and stuff like swimmers and dives and walking on water. big dive from 25 feet. if you want a good show in vegas without cirque's insane prices this is a good swap. we left pretty impressed.
